 "data": "@startuml
left to right direction

rectangle \"Binance WebSocket\nBTC/USDT, ETH/USDT\" as WS
rectangle \"Producer\nPython\" as PROD
rectangle \"Redpanda Cloud\nKafka API\" as RP
rectangle \"PySpark Structured Streaming\nEC2 m7i-flex.large\" as SPARK

rectangle \"Bronze\nRaw Trade Ticks\" as BRONZE
rectangle \"Silver\n1-min VWAP\nTrade Count\nOHLC\" as SILVER
rectangle \"Gold\nOFI\nVolatility\nMomentum\nSignal\" as GOLD

rectangle \"GitHub Actions\nBatch Gold Jobs\" as GHA

WS --> PROD : Trade Ticks
PROD --> RP : JSON Ticks
RP --> SPARK : Kafka API
SPARK --> BRONZE : Write
BRONZE --> SILVER : Clean + Aggregate
SILVER --> GOLD : Features
GHA --> GOLD : Batch

rectangle \"Binance Historical Klines\n4 Years\" as KL
rectangle \"Local CSVs\" as CSV
rectangle \"Pandas Features\" as FEAT
rectangle \"Models\nXGBoost\nLightGBM\nRidge\nGARCH\" as MODELS
rectangle \"README Findings\" as FIND
rectangle \"DuckDB Data Quality Checks\" as DUCK
rectangle \"Streamlit Dashboard\nPlanned\" as DASH

KL --> CSV : Download
CSV --> FEAT
FEAT --> MODELS : Train/Test
MODELS --> FIND : Results

GOLD ..> DASH : Planned
GOLD ..> DUCK : Validation

@enduml
